items.stem: A nested model's R² rises from 0.70 to 0.72, while adjusted R² falls from 0.68 to 0.66. The best interpretation is:
options: The new model has lower ordinary fit
The added predictor did not improve the complexity-adjusted fit measure
The new model is necessarily causal
items.explanation: Ordinary R² rose, but the adjustment penalty outweighed the fit improvement.
